dimensions.assessment: Extends authorizations and operations for a specific five-year window spanning fiscal years 2027 through 2031.

importance_detail.rationale: The STORMWATER Act extends the authorization of appropriations for centers of excellence for stormwater control infrastructure technologies through fiscal year 2031 and sets the number of centers at 5, including a mandatory center focused on the Great Lakes region.
